# Draft:Ingeni Coworking

Ingeni Coworking is a network of coworking spaces in the Principality of Andorra, with locations in Andorra la Vella and Escaldes-Engordany. It provides shared workspaces and related services for professionals, entrepreneurs, startups, and small businesses.
Overview
Ingeni Coworking operates three centers: Ingeni Coworking Europa, Ingeni Coworking Ònix, and Ingeni Coworking Escaldes. The organization offers a range of workspace options, including shared desks, dedicated desks, private offices, and meeting rooms.
The stated philosophy of the organization is Create. Connect. Share., which reflects its focus on collaboration and professional interaction. Ingeni Coworking forms part of Andorra’s coworking and remote-work sector.
Facilities and services
Facilities at Ingeni Coworking locations include high-speed internet access, meeting rooms, shared kitchen areas, and common workspaces. Membership plans may include access to events, workshops, and networking activities.
Community
Ingeni Coworking reports a community of more than 300 members from a range of professional backgrounds and nationalities. It is described as the largest coworking community in Andorra.
Locations
* Europa – Andorra la Vella
* Ònix – Andorra la Vella
* Escaldes – Escaldes-Engordany
